title: hieracium sylvaticum subsp. tenuiflorum
intro: Hieracium sylvaticum subsp. tenuiflorum, commonly known as a subspecies of woodland hawkweed, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium sylvaticum subsp. tenuiflorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and confirm its therapeutic actions.
